profile.headline: Minerva University, Class of 2022
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with a background in natural and computational sciences, and a longstanding interest in how people learn, communicate, and make sense of complex information.

I’m particularly interested in science communication, lifelong learning, educational technology, and the ethical and social consequences of how information is created and communicated. I enjoy exploring unfamiliar subjects, understanding them deeply, and finding ways to explain them to others.

My interdisciplinary education at Minerva University took me across six countries and exposed me to people and perspectives from a wide range of cultural and academic backgrounds. That experience continues to shape how I approach problems: with curiosity, an appreciation for different perspectives, and a desire to question assumptions rather than take them for granted.

I’m interested in opportunities where technology, education, communication, and the public understanding of complex ideas intersect.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Facilitated class sessions and supervised the academic development of 62 students across 2 majors
- Evaluated, developed, and revised course materials for Bayesian Stats, Simulation-Driven Development, and Earth Systems Modeling courses

positions.title: Technical Support Agent
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an analytical CRM system leading to a more efficient allocation of technical support efforts
- Diagnosed, classified, and replicated platform bugs and UX flows
- Trained 40 new hires, directly overseeing a group of 4 people for a year
- Counseled hundreds of members from partner organizations, such as Ivy League programs, on an online learning platform in real time

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
- Created and designed the company's new website, following design and communication principles to ensure a unified and comprehensible message was displayed across departments.
- Implemented new data-gathering mechanisms in the company.
- Curated relevant publicity for immigrant communities in three languages for social media accounts.
- Conducted market research across the greater San Jose area.

positions.title: Research Fellow
positions.description:
- Designed an active learning application for SF residents through location-based technology.
- Produced relevant marketing materials for the application with a group of freshmen peers.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Directed four high school leadership camps for 60 students
- Created team-building activities to potentiate interpersonal group in teenagers
- Curated much-needed publicity to attract new students to the program

positions.title: Coordinator
positions.description:
- Actively managed a group of 12 students organizers
- Attracted more than 70 students to participate in group activities on a weekly basis through relevant social media (Facebook, WhatsApp, and Twitter)
- Directed volunteering sessions with Eunime (Orphanage for HIV+ Kids)
- Directed numerous campaigns to provide basic services to flooded and impoverished areas in Tijuana
- Held and organized the group's national gathering with students from 10 other cities (ENNAGA)

educations.schoolName: Instituto Mexico de Baja California (Tijuana, Mexico)

honors.title: National Chemistry Olympiad
honors.description: Top 50 Spot in the advanced category, out of the thousands of high-school competitors nationwide, twice in a row (2017 & 2018).
honors.issuer: Issued by Mexican Academy of Science · Mar 2017

honors.title: National Marist L'Hermitage Debate in Economics
honors.description:
- Researched extensively energetic and labor reforms, and the privatization of public services in Mexico
- Acted as the youngest team lead in the category, managing a team of five people
honors.issuer: Issued by Instituto Valladolid Preparatoria (Morelia, MX) · Nov 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: - Transported necessary aid and refurbished the only middle school in the "Cabeza de Borrego" community in Sierra Tarahumara, MX.
